title: Ride quality and driver involvement
summary: This topic combines comments about the car's ride and driver involvement with a few operational remarks about accuracy and delivery, so the sample is not fully cohesive.

positive.summary: Positive feedback praises the car's actual ride quality.

mixed.summary: Mixed feedback says the car feels modern but lacks real driver involvement.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention heavy electronics reducing driver involvement, plus separate remarks about work accuracy and smooth delivery that do not clearly express overall sentiment.

limitations: The topic cluster mixes vehicle experience comments with sales, delivery, and work-process remarks.
